headline: APEC Leaders Adopt Regional Connectivity Blueprint at Asia-Pacific Summit
summary: The 33rd Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation Economic Leaders' Meeting adopted the APEC Connectivity Blueprint on Thursday. The framework aims to strengthen regional supply chain integration and trade links among member economies.
why: APEC represents 21 Pacific Rim member economies focused on regional trade liberalization and economic cooperation. Inter-regional infrastructure accords aim to reduce international customs friction.
